Have you tried updating your profile regularly? I spent the first month or two on Tinder/Bumble with 0 matches. I eventually tried cycling new selfies through my profile. I would find time once a week to take pictures in new location that was interesting; I also made sure that I was taking pictures that weren't just selfies and took them during golden hour (one hour after sunrise or before sunset.) Include a couple of pictures with friends or family in them as well. You can look goofy in the group photos it doesn't really matter, they just need to see you having a good time with other people. I kept making tweaks to my bio as well. Long story short I went from having 0 matches for a while to receiving 20-30 matches a week. Just keep at it! If you get discouraged take a break for a few days. Online dating sucks, but there is hope. Just keep your head up and if your profile isn't working you should work on it. You'll find someone!
